headline_ko: Select Decks $245M 사기 적발 등 신규 5건
headline_en: Select Decks $245M fraud bust, plus 5 new incidents
briefing_ko:
- **[custom Safe module](https://cointelegraph.com/news/mev-bot-intercepts-77m-in-rseth-from-ethereum-wallet-exploit)** (Ethereum) — 공격자가 Safe 모듈로 rsETH 전송 시도, Yoink 봇이 $7.7M 가로챔.
- **[Fake AI Trading Bot Drainer](https://www.trmlabs.com/resources/blog/fake-ai-trading-bots-are-getting-victims-to-build-their-own-drainers)** (Ethereum) — 224명 피해자에게서 총 $517K 탈취, 계약 배포 후 즉시 운영자 주소 6개로 전송.
- **Select Decks / Vin Phat** — PPP·EIDL 대출 사기, $245M.
- **HEFU CHAI, HUAISONG XIANG** — 내부 정보 이용 불법 이익, $50K each.
- **소액** — Bonfiretoken $50K, SpiralHookV2 $19K (후속). 기존 블랙리스트 1개 재등장.
- **시사점** — 가격 오라클 조작·tx.origin 방어 회피가 연속적으로 악용되고 있다.
briefing_en:
- **[custom Safe module](https://cointelegraph.com/news/mev-bot-intercepts-77m-in-rseth-from-ethereum-wallet-exploit)** (Ethereum) — attacker tried to move rsETH via a Safe module, Yoink bot front-ran and stole $7.7M.
- **[Fake AI Trading Bot Drainer](https://www.trmlabs.com/resources/blog/fake-ai-trading-bots-are-getting-victims-to-build-their-own-drainers)** (Ethereum) — 224 victims sent ~ $517K, instantly forwarded to six operator addresses.
- **Select Decks / Vin Phat** — PPP/EIDL loan fraud, $245M.
- **HEFU CHAI, HUAISONG XIANG** — insider-info illegal profit, $50K each.
- **Smaller** — Bonfiretoken $50K, SpiralHookV2 $19K (follow-up). 1 on our blacklist.
- **Takeaway** — price-oracle manipulation and tx.origin-based defenses keep being exploited.
